te: The Grand Duchy of Lithuania defeats the Livonian Order in the Battle of Karuse.
dz: 立陶宛大公国在卡鲁斯战役中击败了利沃尼亚骑士团.

dz: 耶库诺·阿姆拉克 (Yekuno Amlak) 登上了埃塞俄比亚的皇位，在扎格威 (Zagwe) 空位期 100 年后恢复了所罗门王朝的权力。
de: Yekuno Amlak takes the imperial throne of Ethiopia, restoring the Solomonic dynasty to power after a 100-year Zagwe interregnum.

te: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, durin…
dz: 腓力三世虽然患有痢疾,但在父亲路易九世去世后,在第八次十字军东征期间成为了法国国王. 他的叔叔那不勒斯的查理一世被逼同穆罕默德一世·穆斯坦西尔,突尼斯的哈夫西德苏丹开始和谈.
de: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, during the Eighth Crusade. His uncle, Charles I of Naples, is forced to begin peace negotiations with Muhammad I al-Mustansir, Hafsid Sultan of Tunis.

dz: 第八次十字军东征由安茹的查理一世(取代已去世的弟弟法国国王路易九世)和突尼斯突尼斯的哈夫西德王朝达成协议而结束.
de: The Eighth Crusade ends by an agreement between Charles I of Anjou (replacing his deceased brother King Louis IX of France) and the Hafsid dynasty of Tunis, Tunisia.

te: The Nizari Ismaili garrison of Gerdkuh, Persia surrender after 17 years to the Mongols.
dz: 格尔德库赫的尼扎里·伊斯梅利驻军,波斯17后向蒙古人投降.
